Indonocaismnic Prime Minister Al-Autk Umar Wolf has called for a 10-year Economic Reform.[/b][/u]

[b]Economic Shifts and Objectives[/b]
[u]
Military Efficiency[/u]
The goal is to bring down defense spending to 1214% of the yearly budget while maintaining strategic capability. Emphasis is given to the maximization of local arms manufacturing and transferring defense research and development to civilian technologies. Al-Autk Umar formulated the Defense-Civil Innovation to promote innovation in different fields.

[u]Domestic Market and Export Variety[/u]
With a focus on stimulating domestic consumption through middle-class development and microbusiness support. And kick off the National Consumption Stimulus program by giving tax rebates and subsidies to local products. And prioritize non-commodity-dependent industries like technology, education, health, and cultural tourism.
[u]
Equity and Regional Inclusion[/u]
The government has introduced Unity Investment Zones or UIZ in underdeveloped provinces with tax benefits and infrastructure development. Enact improving Species Equity Legislation for equal pay and opportunities for non-human populations. Through the provision of funding for public housing, healthcare, and clean water in poor neighborhoods.

[u]Environmental and Green Resilience[/u]
To achieve 30% clean energy by 2030 and 60% by 2035 is to invest in renewable energy. By establishing the Climate Adaptation Authority with support for agro-tech R&D and conserving zones of biodiversity. And adopt advanced agro-tech innovations like drought-resistant crops and vertical farming.

[u]Digital and Technology Improvement in Governance Sector[/u]
An integrated digital government operates by 2029 to enhance efficiency and transparency. With Support, grant rural tech startups and start Tech Nation 2035 targeting AI, cybersecurity, and biotech.

[u]City-Country Balance[/u]
Al-Autk Umar addresses urban-rural disparities by investing in regions and balancing resource allocation. By providing civil education, language classes, and national unity initiatives to promote social cohesion.

[b]The Implementation of EEHP Policies[/b]

[u]Visa-Free Travel[/u]
Indonocaismnic will permit tourism and transit travelers to travel without a visa among member states if they have no criminal record. Any member state can decide its own work visa and immigration policy but has to grant human rights and treat everyone equally.

[u]Shared Criminal Database[/u]
Indonocaismnic voluntary participation in a shared criminal database for tracking and collaboration on cross-border crime enforcement. With the ensure of law enforcement cooperation while safeguarding privacy through strict data access protocols.

[u]The 1% Tariff Alignment Agreement[/u]
The proposal agreement of a 1% tax on goods to facilitate trade among member nations, with variable start dates.

[b]10-Year Reform Stages[/b]

[u]Phase 1 of Stabilization and Equity Foundations (20252027)[/u]
With the purpose to reduce corruption, implement Species Equity Laws, and create Urban Improvement Zones in poorer communities. This starts with the shift to clean energy and digitizing government processes. 

[u]Phase 2 of Innovation and Green Transition 20282031[/u]
With a drive to focus on investing in clean energy, advanced agro-tech, and tech innovation. And Launch for passing the education and healthcare reforms to stimulate human capital. 

[u]Phase 3 of Global Expansion and Economic Growth 20322035 [/u]
With a focus on building economic ties and trade without relying on other nations but by establishing economic self-sufficiency with open trade in focus of becoming a Global Tech and Financial Hub.

[spoiler=[b][u]Stranded Far From Home.[/u]
Till we dream on a Sunrise.[/b]
[nation]Indonocaismnic[/nation] [nation]United Hydronia[/nation]]
[i]The night is heavy with the distant storm ceasing to be, breathing masks hang gently from their compartment with emergency lights glowing green to their exits.
660 souls including the crew of the aircraft with the only casualties being Pilot, co-pilot and a young flight attendee, as for the rest of the passengers would wake up to their natural senses to the scenario they now are in.
The reality of every man, woman and child on a island they know little about would become ever increasingly worrying, the chosen leaders of the survivors would take an hour's worth of calming down before a selected group was chosen.
This group of 8 to represent the 660 different people, spoke in their native tongue but know enough to understand one another well enough to work together.
With everyone still inside the aircraft, one of the doors had to be closed down as the cool breeze outside brought discomfort for the young.
The reason for the door and deployed inflatable ramp at the front of the aircraft was the act of not just 1, but of 13 panicked passengers who now are unknown to where they ran off to.
As the quietness develops for the now stranded people, all they can do is wait for the sun to rise...

But as a child looks out a window, she glimpsed at a strange light afar in the distance...
Before she could identify what she is looking at, it vanishes into the darkness of plain and empty landscape of sand and dry soil.
She'll be the only one who knows that every passenger on the Boeing 747 are all strangers in a strange land, and no one she knows would believe her warning. [/i][/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b][u]Stranded Far From Home.[/u]
The Sands of Time.[/b]
[nation]Indonocaismnic[/nation]
[nation]United Hydronia[/nation]
[nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation]
[nation]New Westmore[/nation]]
[i]The brightest light since the dawn of life awakes in the horizon, Ardagan, the sun of the solar system.
The light shines to uncover what is now pristine lands untouched by any man of the modern period, the clear ocean to the south, the extraordinary mountain and its significant but distinct landmark at its peak, to the west witj the golden dunes and to the east with dry but dancing forests.
The air is clean as the blue skys above, this place is unreal to be true but Mother Erene doesn't lie, her voice is true.

With the sun rising the plan is set in motion, around 100 individuals and another 100 more are both tasked to discover but also to collect resources to fill the stockpiles in the aircraft, the rest who stay are to do little tasks and not lose their sanity.
The first to discover is what has happened to the run away people, there where different shoe imprints in the soil and as the team of 20 followed them it became hard to distinguish as the enviroment appears to have masked them over short moment of time.
But this group had to consider splitting up to spread their search, for just 13 people out of 660, it shouldn't be too difficult...

And with their search, they managed to find them, not in the shape the folk wanted as the scream of a women who was part of the search team echoed the silence. 
Those who headed to the scream found her sobbing intensively with both hands covering her face, for what she has found her lover petrified and hollow, buried in the sand.
But that's not all as they dug around the corpse of a lover, more showed up, more dug their nails into the sands and with what they now see are 12 bodies.
All where petrified with what appears to be random deep cuts and deep holes over their bodies.
They were attacked by something in the night, something so viscous and cruel that it would bury the dead.
1 was however missing as it was found out amongst the corpses on blood soaked dirt, this concludes for a rather believable person as he speaks to them with consern, 
"What ever has killed these people is surely to return, like a squirrel burrying its nuts in the sand."
So they believed him, a mans theory is enough, so with the bodies they hold on makeshift sleds they carried, they would struggle with sorrow on their backs as the sands shift with time for the sun's light burning brightly...
The unseen sharks now swim the dunes, to follow behind their prey with their prayers fulfilled by the grace of the sun.[/i][/spoiler]
[spoiler=[b][u]Stranded Far From Home.[/u]
Respect and Thirst.[/b]
[nation]Indonocaismnic[/nation]
[nation]United Hydronia[/nation]
[nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation]
[nation]New Westmore[/nation]][i]The first group to arive back at the crashed aircraft was those whom have now grown tired and stained with blood, as the effort to bring the remains of people would backfire against the people who still shelter, the crooked aircraft is hot to the touch and as for its passengers, they continue to withstand the heat with their available equipment.
The exploration team's appearance along with the fallen causes an uncertain paranoia of what unknown beasts of the island could be.
The last person along with his sled in view are now in a sluggish manner as he struggles under the heat, even as someone called out for water for the suffering man, he ends up collapsing into the dusty winds.

Scavenging through the inventory of the food cupboards, water and other drinks are coming to a troublesome position, at this rate if they don't find a watersource, dehydration would most likely kill them.
So as one of the last few bottles of water is now in hand, it was passed along to a young man who headed off quickly to help the collapsed hydron.
Triping on the light dune, the energetic young man climbs to the edge to pull the hydron to lean on him with knees digging into the sand.

Panting, sweating and skin burnt, he gulped down the liquid that was poured gently down his arid throat until the last drop.
With a sigh, the hydron smiled at the young man, grateful for being saved he stands up and gestures to be helped with the sled of the unfortunate pile.
With all hands on the rope, both the vespurian and hydron, two strangers in a strange land now work against the sun as they begin pulling...

As they pull with their strengths, it moves forward gradually just for a moment till it starts to stop, then their own power is fought against them as the weight is pulling them back down the dune.
The hydron's hands slip and falls over on his back along with the vespurian who quickly figured it would be bad to be dragged down by the sled, with all hands let go of the seating belt rope, the sled slides down to the bottom from the dune's hight.
The young vespurian rushes back up to see how far it went down, before he could decide what to do next, the sled of casualties begin to sink on one side as the front is pushed up, by what appears to be a rising lump erupting out the sand.

His voice is silent, but his shadow is loud, the sand shakes away off the lump, revealing in his eyes is a horrible mash of shells and crab molded on a masked thing in yellow, looking directly back at the vespurian...
[/i][/spoiler]
